reference_conventions.primordial_rule: Hold A_s, n_s and other primordial parameters fixed for raw theory-response comparisons unless an explicitly documented nuisance projection is applied.
reference_conventions.matter_power_rule: P_m means the solver's total clustering non-relativistic matter spectrum for the explicitly documented component set. Never compare two solvers before matching this component definition.
reference_conventions.growth_normalization_rule: Never independently impose D(a=1)=1 when amplitude information is being compared. Use common early-time/primordial normalization or P_m at fixed A_s.

derived_or_optional_channels.name: ap_response
derived_or_optional_channels.rule: Derived geometric response. Do not count it as independent if its parent geometry coordinates are already present.

derived_or_optional_channels.name: growth_rate
derived_or_optional_channels.rule: Optional discriminant channel; f=d ln D/d ln a is normalization independent.

derived_or_optional_channels.name: power_shape_quotient
derived_or_optional_channels.formula: r_P with the constant log-amplitude mode projected out using the same covariance/precision metric as the analysis
derived_or_optional_channels.rule: Derived quotient. Never concatenate raw r_P and its amplitude-quotiented copy in one rank calculation.

derived_or_optional_channels.name: weyl_metric_response
derived_or_optional_channels.rule: Optional until a common gauge-invariant extractor is validated across all solver families; do not use raw gauge-specific metric variables as common coordinates.

rank_rules: Whiten with the observational/noise covariance before any rank claim.
Project exact definitions, Bianchi/conservation identities, calibration modes and measurement-induced nuisance directions before law discovery.
Do not count a derived channel and its parent coordinates simultaneously as independent dimensions.
Use only complete/common channel blocks when comparing model families unless a missing-data method has been separately validated.
Propagate theory-family weights into the null calibration used for R_model(pi).
All solver commits, gauges, component definitions and numerical precision settings must be recorded in provenance.

scale_policy.linear_core: k <= 0.1 h/Mpc is the default common linear-theory block for G3B/G5 rank tests.
scale_policy.extension: 0.2-1.0 h/Mpc is diagnostic/extension space and is not mixed into the linear core without an explicit nonlinear validity gate.
scale_policy.ultra_large_scale: k < 0.001 h/Mpc is excluded from the first common GDM/CDM regression rank block because the pinned GDM_CLASS zero-closure branch has a documented finite-start initial-condition sensitivity there. It remains a separately tracked diagnostic sector, not discarded evidence.
